DLF15_A.copy: Hook: the denture cup found under Mom's sink.
DLF15_A.prompt: Extreme close-up of an old plastic denture cup pulled from under a bathroom sink: a partial denture inside murky yellow-brown water with a slimy film floating on top, black specks on the cup's rim, dusty plain white tablet boxes stacked behind. Gross-out realism: shot extremely close with the harsh direct phone flash, wet glistening highlights, every disgusting detail sharp. It should make the viewer physically recoil, like an unedited photo someone posted to complain. Realistic, not cartoonish, no blood, no gore, no text, no logos, every box, bottle and package plain white or grey with no printing.
